Open to full-stack, AI engineer and Python developer roles in Coimbatore (office or hybrid) or remote in India.

## Experience

- Web Developer, Onwords Private Limited, Coimbatore (2026 to present): builds and maintains client websites and web applications across frontend and backend.

## Projects

- [Mutual Aid House](https://mutual-aid-house.vercel.app): production direct-selling platform for a client, built at Onwords. NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL API with a Next.js admin panel, Cashfree checkout, a binary commission engine, KYC-verified bank/UPI payouts, refunds with commission clawback, tests, and GitHub Actions deployment. Code is private.
- [Support Pilot AI](https://github.com/binumadhavan2-prog/support-pilot-ai): AI support copilot (personal project). Claude triages tickets and drafts replies grounded in company documents with citations; a human approves every reply. RAG with local multilingual embeddings in pgvector, an evaluation harness, PII redaction and prompt-injection defences. Next.js 16, TypeScript, Drizzle, Docker.
- [Kalyan Finance](https://kalyan-finance.vercel.app): client website built at Onwords. React site with an English/Tamil toggle, a loan repayment calculator and an enquiry form.
- [Neema Homes](https://neema-homes-nine.vercel.app): interior design website (trial project at Onwords, not launched). React with a Supabase admin dashboard secured by Auth and row-level security.
- Carys Wedding (WeDay.in): team-built wedding vendor marketplace at Onwords; Binu built the Razorpay payment integration for vendor listing fees and handled testing and debugging.
- [Kavacham](https://github.com/binumadhavan2-prog/kavacham): Windows security and cleanup app in Python (personal project). Microsoft Defender scans plus its own engine with signatures, heuristics and quarantine; USB and Android phone scanning.
- [Monkey Play](https://github.com/binumadhavan2-prog/monkey-play): animated desktop companion for Windows and Android with reminders, weather and an AI chat (personal project).
- BigMart: online grocery management web app in Python and MySQL (academic project, Luminar Technolab, 2022–2023).
